 CJP founder Abhijith Dipke on Saturday said his party's fight against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar would continue until an independent and impartial electoral system was ensured in the country. Speaking to reporters after arriving at Cochin International Airport to attend the 'Jantar Mantar at Kochi' protest organised by Cockroach Janata Party (CJP) against the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls and Kumar, Dipke alleged that elections under the present CEC could not be trusted.
